page.overview:
Who is Ephred?

() is an elf pastry baker of Jrusar known as the Shadow Baker. As an NPC, he is played by Matthew Mercer.

Ephred is an elf. He is tall, handsome, and in his thirties; he has dark skin, deep brown eyes, a shaven head, and is described as looking very similar to Lance Reddick. He wears a heavy, gray, patterned woolen cloak across his shoulders.

Ephred has an intense presence; he is described as giving off the impression of being a "powerful creature". He has the charisma of a charming salesman but also maintains a mysterious demeanor. He speaks in a deep voice with a Marquesian accent.

The Shadow Baker regularly sells his "colorful, wonderful-smelling baked goods" at Elder's Post. He keeps them hidden in pouches under his cloak like a seller of contraband, and his true intentions are unclear. Ephred describes himself as a "curator of fine pastries", and says that he does not wish to become a renowned baker but bakes only for "those that need what I have to offer." Amongst his wares are sold a blackberry citrus cinnamon roll with purple and orange icing and purple sprinkles and a bright pink bear claw. He harbors a disdain for pies. Yash Mangal refers to his baked goods as "phantom pastries".
